progress: Mixed, the digital agency's board was seated seven years after the strategy designed it while the strategy itself is unrevised and its measurement body has never been created
summary: The [2028 strategy is unrevised and still the stated delivery frame](2026-07-27-km-anaden-conseil-administration), while the [agency's board was seated in July 2026](2026-07-30-gazette-comores-anaden-bureau-conseil-administration).
developments:
The strategy has been [in force since December 2018 with six axes and thirteen strategic orientations costed at KMF 52,995,160,485](2018-12-01-comores-strategie-comores-numerique-2028), and no mid-term review, revision or successor is on file.

2026-07 - the agency [held its first board session, members having been named by decree of 11 June 2026, adopting rules of procedure, electing a bureau and examining the 2026 action plan](2026-07-27-km-anaden-conseil-administration), the [bureau's composition reported separately](2026-07-30-gazette-comores-anaden-bureau-conseil-administration). It had operated without constituted governance organs until then.

The [observatory designed in the same strategy as one of three bodies still does not exist, its establishment now to be paid for by an external loan with no domestic appropriation](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden) - the sector-measurement body whose absence is why no Comorian connectivity indicator series exists.

summary: The digital code's [own 2024 adoption target passed with nothing adopted](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique), and nothing since 2021 re-dates it.
developments:
The code was [recorded in March 2021 as not adopted, with a 2024 target already at risk](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique). That target passed and the code is still not adopted, checked at 2026-08-04.

The target was set by the digital agency itself, and nothing since 2021 records the programme as abandoned or re-dated. The whole legislative position for this country is known through one agency account five years old, which is why the staleness is the finding rather than any particular status.

summary: The [2021 data protection law is in force, aligned to the European regulation, with the national authority still not constituted](2025-07-23 Review of the Comoros Data Protection Law).
developments:
The law was [enacted on 29 June 2021, is extraterritorial, requires seventy-two-hour breach notification and a mandatory data-protection officer and carries full data-subject rights, with the national authority not constituted](2025-07-23 Review of the Comoros Data Protection Law).

Nothing moved. The authority's non-existence was [restated in a procurement notice of 12 March 2026](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden). The statute is held only through an analyst review and is cited as analysis; its own text is not held, so what a Comorian controller must actually do is not checkable from anything on file.

summary: [Cybercrime provisions sit at articles 449 to 505 of the penal code](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique); the separate cybersecurity law is drafted and not enacted.
developments:
The [penal code, promulgated by presidential decree on 16 February 2021, covers technology-specific offences, online intellectual-property infringement, illicit conduct on electronic communications networks and online service-provider liability at articles 449 to 505](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique). The country criminalised cyber conduct inside the general penal code rather than in a digital statute.

No prosecution, caseload or enforcement figure is on file at either end. The separate cybersecurity law is recorded as drafted and not enacted, and the base carries no position on it dated after March 2021 - five years stale at both ends of the window.

summary: The [e-commerce law is still to be drafted](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique), and no [electronic-signature instrument exists](2018-12-01-comores-strategie-comores-numerique-2028).
developments:
The e-commerce law was [recorded as still to be drafted in March 2021 and is unchanged](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique), as is a [revised public procurement code for procurement conducted electronically, drafted and not enacted, with no procurement platform on record](2021-03-04-com-anaden-avancees-code-numerique).

An electronic-signature instrument was [named as a legal vacuum by the state's own 2018 strategy](2018-12-01-comores-strategie-comores-numerique-2028) and none is on file at 2026-08-04 - the last of six gaps the state itself named in 2018 that the base cannot show closed. Without a signature instrument, none of the paperless procedures being procured elsewhere in this report has a legal basis for the act it would replace.

progress: No change, a stand-up consultancy has now been procured
summary: The authority is [still not created five years after the statute, its establishment financed entirely by external lenders](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden).
developments:
It has been [provided for in law since 29 June 2021 and never constituted](2025-07-23 Review of the Comoros Data Protection Law).

2026-03-12 - [institutional capacity and a stand-up consultancy were procured under the e-government project, with submissions open to 12 March 2027 and no domestic appropriation attached](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden); creating the authority is also a [stated component of the continental bank's digitisation project](2024-10-06 Comoros to implement digital govt program with AfDB grant (Digitization of the Comorian Economy)).

Five years from statute to procurement notice, with no operating date on file and the supervisor of Comorian personal data to be paid for by two foreign lenders.

summary: A [programme for African island economies launched in July 2026](2026-07-24-auda-nepad-island-economies-programme-launch) with digital transformation among six pillars.
developments:
2026-07-24 - the programme was [launched at an Abidjan ministerial segment with a 2026-2031 roadmap covering the seven African island states, digital transformation one of six pillars and digital public infrastructure, artificial intelligence and automation named as its accelerators](2026-07-24-auda-nepad-island-economies-programme-launch).

Ministers adopted a communique committing to it, and it is advanced with a bilateral partner, a development bank, the regional economic communities and the Indian Ocean Commission. No Comorian component, financing figure or national milestone is stated, so nothing on file says what this country undertakes under it.

summary: The [2024 quality-of-service audit is still the only edition](2024-11-01-com-anrtic-audit-qualite-de-service-2024), and the [regulator has never published a statutory annual report](2025-07-17-com-anrtic-decision-25-001-catalogue-acces-comores-cables-2025-2026).
developments:
The [2024 audit measured both operators against twenty-three quality indicators over three months and was presented at a Moroni workshop, with a quarterly bulletin requested by the minister and none produced](2024-11-01-com-anrtic-audit-qualite-de-service-2024). Its finding was coverage gaps requiring operators to redouble their efforts, and eight years after market liberalisation it is the first published quality measurement in the base. No 2025 or 2026 audit and no quarterly bulletin is on file.

An annual activity report has been [required by statute since promulgation on 2 February 2024](2024-02-02-com-decret-24-003-pr-promulgation-loi-23-024-au-communications-electroniques), and the [regulator's own site states that none has yet been published](2025-07-17-com-anrtic-decision-25-001-catalogue-acces-comores-cables-2025-2026) - an empty series the regulator states itself.

summary: The [country-code domain registry has sat in a stated transitional arrangement for fifteen months](2025-05-12-cctld-km-transfer-anaden-registry-lagazette), re-delegation incomplete.
developments:
The registry [transferred from the incumbent operator to the digital agency overnight on 6 to 7 May 2025 under a ministerial order of 29 September 2024](2025-05-08-cctld-km-transfer-comores-telecom-to-anaden-alwatwan), with [physical equipment still hosted at the incumbent and re-delegation to the international body pending](2025-05-12-cctld-km-transfer-anaden-registry-lagazette).

Unchanged: the re-delegation is not recorded as completed and the announced online registration platform is not recorded as deployed. Fifteen months in a stated transitional arrangement, and both accounts derive from the same agency communique, so the country's own top-level domain is described by one source and confirmed by none.

summary: A [first national artificial-intelligence forum was held at Moroni in April 2026](2026-04-01-premier-forum-intelligence-artificielle-alwatwan) under ministry patronage.
developments:
2026-04 - the [first edition was held on the theme of digital inclusion under ministry patronage, with the digital agency, the regulator, the technology association and the university taking part](2026-04-01-premier-forum-intelligence-artificielle-alwatwan).

No second edition, communique or follow-up instrument is held. The minister called it a starting point, and nothing on file says it produced anything. It is the only convening on digital policy the base records for this country in the window, and the non-state participants are a professional association and a university rather than civil society.

summary: The information and communication code was [amended with the government's proposed exception to source protection struck on the floor](2025-12-29-com-alwatwan-assemblee-adopte-lf2026-et-loi-de-finances-rectificative-2025).
developments:
The 2021 statute stood unamended at 292 articles. The Assembly of the Union [adopted an amending law by 31 votes of 33 deputies, amending twenty-five articles and deleting eighteen, with the government's proposed exception to source protection struck on the floor, so source protection is now unqualified](2025-12-29-com-alwatwan-assemblee-adopte-lf2026-et-loi-de-finances-rectificative-2025).

Neither the amending law's text nor a promulgating decree is held, and the whole account is one national-press report of the plenary. A legislature narrowing a government's own proposed exception is the clearest instance of open contest over digital policy the base records for this country.

progress: Mixed, the digital ministry's vote rose 51.66% and a finance-ministry systems directorate was funded at three times it while the digital chamber's line was cut and the regulator appears in no budget at all
summary: The digital ministry's vote rose to [KMF 338,724,932 for 2026](2026-01-16-com-2026-09-0902), while the [finance ministry's systems directorate took KMF 277,128,000](2026-01-16-com-2026-08-0825).
developments:
The digital ministry went from [KMF 235,315,816 for 2025, revised to KMF 223,337,645](2025-12-29-com-alwatwan-assemblee-adopte-lf2026-et-loi-de-finances-rectificative-2025), to [KMF 338,724,932 for 2026, up 51.66 per cent, including the first appropriated state capital line for the ministry in the three-year corpus at KMF 50,000,000](2026-01-16-com-2026-09-0902) - about 0.34 per cent of the ministry block, roughly EUR 690,000.

The largest single digital appropriation sits elsewhere: the [finance ministry's information systems directorate took KMF 277,128,000 against a revised 2025 comparator of nil on every line](2026-01-16-com-2026-08-0825), 82 per cent of the whole digital ministry's vote.

The [digital chamber's transfer line fell to KMF 50,000,000 from KMF 73,000,000](2026-01-16-com-2026-09-0910). The 2024 outturn was [KMF 183,586,075, 26.89 per cent of the rectified appropriation](2023-11-27-com-2024-09), and the [regulator, funded wholly by statutory levy, is absent from every budget instrument for a third consecutive year](2024-02-02-com-decret-24-003-pr-promulgation-loi-23-024-au-communications-electroniques). The one digital line outside the digital ministry that the base can trace, a [website and internet consumption line, was cut to KMF 15,000,000 by a ministerial virement six weeks before the 2024 year end and has had no published position since](2024-11-01-com-2024-31-9998-6153).

summary: A [card and merchant partnership with a global payment network was announced across five markets](2025-11-29-axian-mastercard-digital-payments-partnership-techreviewafrica) including this one.
developments:
2025-11 - a [partnership was announced covering virtual and physical cards plus merchant solutions through a group's wallet brands across five markets including the Comoros](2025-11-29-axian-mastercard-digital-payments-partnership-techreviewafrica). It is the only source on this subject the base holds for the country, and no Comoros launch date, volume or value is stated.

2025-06 - a [protocol was signed at Moroni with the agriculture chambers, its objectives including a national digital agricultural register and building the chambers' digital capacity](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec). The register is named as an objective with no build, timetable, financier or budget line on record, and no dated progress on the protocol is held.

summary: A [EUR 25m operator loan was agreed in June 2025](2025-06-20-yas-comoros-ifc-25m-loan-techafricanews) with no drawdown, spend, site count or coverage outcome held.
developments:
2025-06-20 - a [EUR 25,000,000 loan was agreed to the second mobile operator, a prior EUR 13m facility from 2019 having been fully repaid that month, with deployment stated to begin in 2025 for fifth-generation, fibre to the home and to the office, and inter-island connectivity](2025-06-20-yas-comoros-ifc-25m-loan-techafricanews). No drawdown, spend, site count or coverage outcome is held, and the [group's 2026 restatement adds no delivery figure](2026-02-02-axian-telecom-next-2030-vision-comoros-techreviewafrica). The [lender's own project disclosure is not held](2025-01-01-ifc-com-2025-yas-comoros-broadband-bw03).

A [US$82,000,000 pledge across three countries including this one, targeting 97 per cent population coverage and six million connected by 2030, has no country split, interim milestone or progress report on file](2025-04-01-axian-telecom-82m-4g-madagascar-comoros-tanzania-techafricanews), so no Comorian position can be derived from it.

progress: Advanced, on procurement notices rather than delivery
summary: A [general procurement notice opened the e-government project in March 2026](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden), with no domestic appropriation on any component.
developments:
The continental bank's digitisation project was [launched over 27 to 28 March 2025 as a four-year programme](2025-03-20-padec-afdb-digital-economy-project-ptab-validation-lagazette), with [US$4,511,079 disbursed of a US$5,985,000 commitment and no delivery milestone published in the sixteen months since](2024-01-01-afdb-com-001-comoros---project-to-support-the). Its envelope is unreconciled: an [entity page carries EUR 9,510,000 approved against a total project cost of EUR 22,530,000](2024-01-01-afdb-com-001-comoros---project-to-support-the).

A second lender committed [a US$400,000 grant and a US$6,500,000 loan, nothing disbursed as at 2026-06-24 against a planned start of 23 September 2025](2025-01-01-isdb-com-padec-digitalization-2025-project-for-the-digitalization-of-the); it carries the same acronym as the first and nothing settles whether they are one operation or two.

2026-03-12 - the [e-government notice issued on a loan of 5,000,000 Islamic dinars, one component financed entirely by one bank and another entirely by the other, with no domestic appropriation attaching to any](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden).

summary: Both fifth-generation services stand where they launched: [one pilot site](2025-06-04-comores-telecom-5g-launch-wttx-lagazette) and [two districts of the capital](2026-02-02-axian-telecom-next-2030-vision-comoros-techreviewafrica).
developments:
The incumbent's service is [live at one pilot site at a claimed rate of up to 1 Gbit/s](2025-06-04-comores-telecom-5g-launch-wttx-lagazette), the rate being the operator's own claim rather than a measurement, and [no second site, coverage or subscriber figure has been published since](2025-02-01-comores-telecom-2024-results-5g-wttx-plans-alwatwan).

The second operator's service is [live in two districts of Moroni, with extension to the other two islands announced](2025-05-20-yas-comores-5g-launch-huawei-lagazette), and its [group's own 2026 restatement names no new site](2026-02-02-axian-telecom-next-2030-vision-comoros-techreviewafrica).

No penetration, subscriber or coverage series exists for this country at all - the measurement body the 2018 strategy designed was never created.

summary: The entry fibre offer moved to [KMF 30,000 a month at 850 GB](2026-07-15-comores-telecom-nouvelles-offres), from KMF 32,500 at 800 GB.
developments:
The basic fibre offer stood at KMF 32,500 a month for 800 GB, and is now [KMF 30,000 a month at 850 GB with unlimited fixed-line calls, plus embedded subscriber-identity migration at KMF 5,000 and a new one at KMF 10,000](2026-07-15-comores-telecom-nouvelles-offres).

It is operator-announced, the source's own dateline is internally inconsistent and the date precision is flagged uncertain. No mobile tariff, basket or affordability measure exists anywhere on this ledger, so one incumbent's fixed offer is the whole of the price evidence for the country.

summary: A [connectivity project reached readiness-stage funding talks in August 2026](2026-08-14-comores-bad-mcdf-connectivite-numerique); the 2018 supplier loan has no delivered site count.
developments:
2026-08-10 - two lenders [told the finance ministry they are ready to fund feasibility studies as a grant for a project carried by the digital agency covering data-centre studies and inter-island connectivity](2026-08-14-comores-bad-mcdf-connectivite-numerique). No commitment amount, study contract or timetable is stated, so it is readiness-stage discussion.

The standing position is a [CNY 567,000,000 concessional loan signed in December 2018 at thirty-year maturity funding a US$81m supplier contract for fibre extension to fifty-seven sites](2018-01-01-eximbank-cn-com-001-china-eximbank-provides-rmb-567-million), with no site count delivered, no completion status and no repayment position held at either end. It is still the largest tracked deal in the base for this country.

summary: The regulator [approved the state cable company's 2025-2026 access catalogue](2025-07-17-com-anrtic-decision-25-001-catalogue-acces-comores-cables-2025-2026), setting wholesale international connectivity prices.
developments:
2025-07-17 - a regulator decision [approved the access catalogue, setting the wholesale prices at which a state-owned company sells the country's international connectivity](2025-07-17-com-anrtic-decision-25-001-catalogue-acces-comores-cables-2025-2026).

The tariff schedule itself is a separate document and is not held, the regulator publishes no decision series so no prior catalogue exists in the base, and the held decision is an excerpt of a two-page scan. What the country pays for international capacity, and whether the approved prices moved, cannot be stated from anything on file.

summary: A [ministerial circular of 9 June 2025 prohibits installation, testing, deployment and use of satellite internet](2025-06-13-starlink-banned-pending-licence-anrtic-alwatwan), pending a licence.
developments:
The circular was [signed on 9 June 2025 and announced by the regulator on 12 June, with installation, testing, deployment and use all prohibited and no licence issued](2025-06-13-starlink-banned-pending-licence-anrtic-alwatwan).

It is still in force on the record: no licence, no lifting and no enforcement outcome is held. The circular's own text is not held, a field inspection to identify and notify users was announced with no outcome on file, and whether the operator has since been authorised is expressly not established - which for an archipelago whose inter-island connectivity is itself at feasibility-study stage is the material gap.

summary: A [public-administration data centre entered service in May 2025](2025-05-15 Comoros completes construction of public administration data centre (ANADEN)), and the [finance ministry tendered two more](2025-12-22-com-mfbsb-appel-doffres-datacenters-pagf-si).
developments:
2025-05-19 - a data centre was [inaugurated, certified to the third tier with a stated hosting capacity of 44.4 terabits, co-managed by the digital agency and the state cable company](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec), its [construction completed shortly before](2025-05-15 Comoros completes construction of public administration data centre (ANADEN)). Tier and capacity are agency-reported, the service-entry date is disputed between accounts, and no capacity utilisation, redundancy arrangement, tenant list or operating-cost figure has been published in the fourteen months since.

2025-12-22 - the finance ministry [tendered primary and backup data centres on French development financing, covering structured local and wireless networks, firewalls, intrusion prevention, security event management and two network operations centres, with bids opened 16 February 2026 and no award, contractor or delivery date recorded](2025-12-22-com-mfbsb-appel-doffres-datacenters-pagf-si) - a second and third state data centre procured by a different ministry from the agency's.

summary: An [interoperability platform was opened to procurement in March 2026](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden) with nothing built, no supplier and no target date.
developments:
The platform was [provided for in the continental bank project approved in October 2024, with nothing built](2024-10-06 Comoros to implement digital govt program with AfDB grant (Digitization of the Comorian Economy)). Contracts were [opened under the e-government procurement notice, and still nothing is built, with no supplier, no architecture and no target date on record](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden). A [second donor project launched in October 2025 provides for its own interoperability layer](2025-10-16-e-administration-project-launch-eu-expertise-france-alwatwan), and neither operates.

A [feasibility study on interfacing the tax system with mobile banking was tendered with expressions of interest due 28 October 2025](2025-10-07-com-mfbsb-ami-interfacage-sigit-mobile-banking-pagf-si); no award, study or interface is on record.

summary: A [new supplier took over biometric document production on 31 March 2026, with data domiciled in the Comoros](2026-04-01-genkey-officially-succeeds-semlex-biometric-production-alwatwan).
developments:
A build-operate-transfer contract had run since 2007 with [all Comorian biometric data stored in Belgium and one production machine, at Moroni](2026-01-01-genkey-to-replace-semlex-from-april-data-domiciled-in-comoros-alwatwan).

2026-03-25 - the [outgoing supplier handed the biometric data to the government](2026-03-25-semlex-hands-biometric-data-to-comoros-government-alwatwan), and on 31 March a [new supplier formally succeeded it, with data domiciled in the Comoros, production decentralised to the two other islands and a polycarbonate laser-engraved data page with a compliant chip](2026-04-01-genkey-officially-succeeds-semlex-biometric-production-alwatwan). [Production was suspended from early to late March during the handover](2026-03-06-biometric-document-production-suspended-semlex-genkey-transition-alwatwan).

Contract length, value and financing source are stated nowhere in the base.

summary: The [personal identification number's technical, legal and institutional framework was validated at a Moroni workshop](2026-03-26-amecc-civil-registry-computerisation-validation-workshop-alwatwan).
developments:
The number was [provided for by the law of 27 July 2023 with nothing on record being built](2026-03-27-comoros-civil-registry-digitisation-pin-wearetech).

2026-03 - [preparatory studies were validated at a Moroni workshop and the framework agreed, the number designated the cornerstone of citizen identity with interoperability to other state systems specified](2026-03-26-amecc-civil-registry-computerisation-validation-workshop-alwatwan).

No issuance date, coverage target or numbering scheme is published. A cornerstone identifier validated on paper, in a country whose civil-registry agency exists in law and not in fact, is as far as the identity layer has reached.

summary: A [digital identity layer is asserted as a workload of the public-administration data centre](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec), with no architecture or timetable.
developments:
The layer is [asserted by the agency that would run it, the data centre stated to support the national domain name system, digital identity and service portals, with no architecture, standard, supplier, timetable or coverage target, and no counterpart line at any grain in the 2025 or 2026 vote](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec). It reaches the base through a rolling agency page dated by proxy.

A [biometric driving-licence programme, named in the 2025 budget bill, is still named in no finance law at any grain, with no instrument, tender, supplier or issuance date on record](2026-01-16-com-2026-06-0615), and the [2026 classification carries no line for it, nor for a national identity card, biometric enrolment, passport system or voter register](2024-11-20-com-mfbsb-expose-des-motifs-projet-loi-de-finances-2025).

summary: The central bank's [interbank settlement system entered service on 23 April 2026](2026-05-04-com-bcc-lancement-komorpay-komor-switch-mali-ya-wakazi), cutting cheque settlement to one working day.
developments:
The system [entered service on 23 April 2026 with a presidential launch on 4 May, operating over a dedicated 120 km fibre network, with an automated clearing leg under KMF 10,000,000 and a real-time gross settlement leg above it, cheque settlement falling from two or three days to one working day](2026-05-12-bcc-livret-nouveaux-moyens-de-paiement-komorpay-mali-ya-wakazi-komor-switch). It is interbank only, with no retail leg, and was [launched alongside two other systems](2026-05-05-komorpay-komor-switch-payment-systems-presidential-launch-alwatwan).

Volumes are [more than 150 transfers a day worth about KMF 125,000,000 and 850 cheques a day worth about KMF 1,000,000,000 on the clearing leg, and about forty operations a day for KMF 3,700,000,000 on the gross settlement leg](2026-05-12-bcc-livret-nouveaux-moyens-de-paiement-komorpay-mali-ya-wakazi-komor-switch), operator-stated and published without an as-of date.

A [government securities market has regulations in force, actors trained and pilot tests passed but first operations not launched, after eight monetary-fund missions over three years](2026-05-06-com-mayottehebdo-lancement-nouveaux-systemes-de-paiement-chiffres).

summary: A [decentralised digital financial institution was licensed in February 2026](2026-02-24-axian-digital-financial-institution-licence-comoros-itweb), and an [agent-banking network is still in test](2026-05-12-bcc-livret-nouveaux-moyens-de-paiement-komorpay-mali-ya-wakazi-komor-switch).
developments:
2026-02 - the central bank [licensed a separately regulated entity under prudential supervision offering mobile nano- and micro-credit alongside the group's existing wallet, on a branchless model](2026-02-24-axian-digital-financial-institution-licence-comoros-itweb). It is [company-announced and reproduced near-verbatim by both outlets](2026-02-24-axian-central-bank-approval-digital-finance-institution-techafricanews); no central-bank statement, licence instrument or regulation establishing the category is held, and the underlying payment-services and electronic-money statute had been adopted five years earlier.

The agent-banking network has been [in test since June 2025 with agents identified and trained and progressive commissioning under way, two microfinance institutions not having signed the conventions](2026-05-12-bcc-livret-nouveaux-moyens-de-paiement-komorpay-mali-ya-wakazi-komor-switch) - eleven months in test with no live date published.

summary: A [national interoperable payment switch went live on 23 August 2025](2025-08-23 PayLogic go-live of Comoros national interoperable payment switch), and a [second switch launched in May 2026](2026-05-04-com-bcc-lancement-komorpay-komor-switch-mali-ya-wakazi).
developments:
The switch was [awarded to a supplier on 16 February 2025](2025-02-20-comoros-paylogic-payment-switch-award-wearetech) and [went live on 23 August 2025 connecting commercial banks, microfinance institutions and mobile-money operators](2025-08-23 PayLogic go-live of Comoros national interoperable payment switch), [reported by two outlets](2025-08-27-paylogic-national-payment-switch-golive-techafricanews).

2026-05-04 - the central bank launched a switch on a [three-phase plan - cross-bank cash withdrawal, then instant bank to mobile-money transfer, then merchant acceptance - with the first phase from July 2026 and online purchases explicitly not covered](2026-05-12-bcc-livret-nouveaux-moyens-de-paiement-komorpay-mali-ya-wakazi-komor-switch).

Whether the two are the same object is unsettled: one account tags the same supplier and nothing on file names a vendor for the later system.

progress: No change, first published figures with nothing earlier behind them
summary: The central bank's 2024 report records [669,584 electronic-money accounts opened, 29.1 per cent active](2026-05-06-com-mayottehebdo-lancement-nouveaux-systemes-de-paiement-chiffres), and a 39 per cent banking rate.
developments:
Relayed from the central bank's own 2024 annual report: [669,584 accounts opened of which 29.1 per cent active, an electronic-money float of KMF 2,700,000,000, and nine banks and financial institutions with 175 branches, twenty-six cash machines and 140 decentralised finance branches](2026-05-06-com-mayottehebdo-lancement-nouveaux-systemes-de-paiement-chiffres), and a [national banking rate of 39 per cent against a projection of 70 per cent by 2030](2026-05-06-com-mayottehebdo-lancement-nouveaux-systemes-de-paiement-chiffres).

The report itself is not held and the figures reach the base second-hand. No earlier dated figure exists, so no direction can be stated, and an earlier banking-rate target for end-2025 is recorded and never measured against.

summary: [Implementation of accession to the pan-African settlement system commenced in August 2024](2024-08-23 Central Bank of Comoros commences PAPSS implementation) and nothing has followed.
developments:
Implementation [commenced on 23 August 2024, the membership agreement having been signed in July 2024, with commercial banks to begin integrating](2024-08-23 Central Bank of Comoros commences PAPSS implementation).

No bank integration, transaction volume or go-live is recorded in the base since. Two years with no follow-up source is itself the finding, in a country whose domestic interbank settlement only entered service in April 2026 - the cross-border rail was joined before the domestic one existed, and neither now has a published corridor figure.

summary: The [civil-registry modernisation programme is running on two islands with a residual financing need of EUR 9,009,900](2026-08-16-comoros-civil-status-modernisation-financing-need).
developments:
A strategic plan was adopted in 2024 with the preliminary study not launched. The [study was validated and the programme is running on the main island since 2 October 2025 and the third island since 10 October, with a residual financing need of EUR 9,009,900 put to an international resource-mobilisation mission and a partners' conference on 14 August 2026](2026-08-16-comoros-civil-status-modernisation-financing-need), the [study launch reported from the third island](2025-10-14-amecc-civil-registry-digitisation-study-launch-moheli-lagazette). The financing need is a consultant's and no share of it is committed on the record.

The [agency provided for by the law of 27 July 2023 is in island consultation on a draft implementing decree and is not recorded as created](2025-11-01-anec-national-civil-status-agency-decree-consultations-lagazette). The directorate that holds the population register and criminal record was [appropriated KMF 4,000,000 for 2026, wholly goods and services](2026-01-16-com-2026-06-0615).

summary: The [single social register holds sixty-two thousand households](2026-07-10-registre-social-unique-62000-households-worldbank-lagazette), described as the most complete socio-economic database built in the country.
developments:
2026-07 - the register is [operating with sixty-two thousand households registered, created by a decree of 23 June 2020, and described by the World Bank's representative as the most complete socio-economic database ever built in the Comoros, its institutional anchoring in the social protection directorate still being structured](2026-07-10-registre-social-unique-62000-households-worldbank-lagazette).

Inter-administration data-sharing protocols are recommended and none is in force. So the most complete population dataset the country holds sits outside any interoperability arrangement, in a state whose data-protection authority does not exist and whose identity number is validated but not issued.

summary: [Digital data capture was used once, for a measles and rubella campaign reaching more than 101,000 children](2025-10-06-comoros-digital-measles-rubella-campaign-odk-wearetech).
developments:
2025-10-04 - a national campaign [used digital capture for the first time, targeting more than 101,000 children across the three islands, with real-time dashboards and maps replacing paper forms](2025-10-06-comoros-digital-measles-rubella-campaign-odk-wearetech).

No institutionalisation, no routine system and no second campaign is on record. It was supported by an international immunisation programme and funded by a vaccine alliance, so the capability arrived with a campaign and is not recorded as having stayed. The base holds no routine national health information system at all.

summary: The [school-records and digital-textbook platforms are unchanged since their June 2025 launch](2025-06-20-comoros-eshiyo-emsomo-edtech-platforms-wearetech), with no school or pupil count published.
developments:
2025-06-05 - two platforms launched at a primary school: [one in pilot for online marks, automatic report cards and a unique pupil identifier, the other a national digital textbook library for pre-primary and primary](2025-06-09-e-msomo-e-shiyo-education-digitisation-anaden-unicef-lagazette).

No school count, pupil count, extension milestone or identifier-issuance figure has been published in the fourteen months since, and the [extension is still under study](2025-06-20-comoros-eshiyo-emsomo-edtech-platforms-wearetech). They are [delivered by the digital agency and a children's fund](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec) rather than by the education vote, which carries no identifiable systems line.

A privately built school-management platform launched at Comor'Lab on 25 August 2026 to centralise pupil enrolment, report cards, examinations, financial tracking, parent communication and online payment of school fees ([platform](2026-08-27-comores-cschool-transformation-numerique-education-alwatwan)). It is a private product: no adoption decision, procurement route or school count is stated, and the hosting association's call for the education ministry to require interoperability with existing systems drew no answer on adoption.

summary: The [legal corpus for electronic tax procedures was validated in April 2026](2026-04-15-com-dgi-validation-cadre-juridique-teleprocedures-fiscales), with activation pending and no date on file.
developments:
The [tax management system is in operation, named in a procurement notice, with no entry-into-service date, supplier, coverage or taxpayer count on record](2025-10-07-com-mfbsb-ami-interfacage-sigit-mobile-banking-pagf-si) - the base holds it only by mention and never by description.

2026-04-15 to 17 - the [statute is in force under the finance law promulgated on 16 January 2026 and the implementing texts were validated at a three-day workshop, with progressive activation pending and no activation date on file](2026-04-15-com-dgi-validation-cadre-juridique-teleprocedures-fiscales), [financed by French development cooperation](2026-04-16-tax-administration-teleprocedures-digitisation-pagf-lagazette) with nothing appropriated in the 2026 vote. The state has a legal basis for collecting tax electronically before it has a rail it owns.

summary: The [e-government project's general procurement notice opened in March 2026](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden); the [scholarship portal has not gone live](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec).
developments:
2026-03-12 - the notice was [issued on a loan of 5,000,000 Islamic dinars, about EUR 5,960,000, with submissions open to 12 March 2027: one component covers a national data centre, an incubator and an orientation centre on the university campus, and another a portal, essential services, an administration payment system and an interoperability platform, each financed entirely by a different lender and none by any domestic appropriation](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden).

The [online scholarship portal has been marked under way on the agency's own delivery log since a technical meeting of June 2024 and is not live on the record](2025-06-01-com-anaden-realisations-numeriques-data-center-e-msomo-padec); no delivery date was ever published, so it is not recorded as stalled. No government services portal or single window exists.

summary: A [Shikomori text-to-speech model went to first public trials](2026-08-04-alwatwan-komori-tts-synthese-vocale-shikomori), privately built and individually funded.
developments:
2026-08 - the model [launched for first public trials, live for Shikomori only, with the translation component still experimental and extension to the three other island languages stalled for want of translators and validators](2026-08-04-alwatwan-komori-tts-synthese-vocale-shikomori). The developer states no Shikomori speech-synthesis model existed before it. It is private and individually funded rather than a state or institutional programme, and the named constraints are processor cost and paired text and audio data volume.

The state's own strand is procurement: an [artificial-intelligence preparedness component is named in the e-government notice with no design, budget line or contract award held](2026-03-12-com-bid-avis-general-passation-marches-e-gouvernement-anaden).

summary: A [digital commerce platform launched nationally in April 2026](2026-04-29-komoralink-digital-commerce-platform-launch-kartapay-lagazette), and a [locally built business software product was launched](2026-04-01-premier-forum-intelligence-artificielle-alwatwan).
developments:
2026-04-29 - a [commerce platform launched across the three islands with a technology partnership and chamber of commerce backing, free to professionals to 31 May 2026](2026-04-29-komoralink-digital-commerce-platform-launch-kartapay-lagazette). No merchant count, transaction volume or post-free-period pricing is held.

At the artificial-intelligence forum, an [enterprise resource planning product built in the Comoros was officially launched, with no user, revenue or deployment figure held](2026-04-01-premier-forum-intelligence-artificielle-alwatwan) - a diaspora-built private product with no entity page in the base.

The incumbent operator reported [KMF 17,035,000,000 of revenue for 2024, up 0.91 per cent, against a 2025 growth target of 11.09 per cent](2025-02-01-comores-telecom-2024-results-5g-wttx-plans-alwatwan); no 2025 outturn is published, so the target is untested.

summary: A [technology park pilot launched in January 2026 at US$4,090,000 over 2025 to 2028](2026-01-29-technopole-numerique-phase-pilote-launch-huawei-alwatwan), targeting 2,000 people trained.
developments:
2026-01-29 - the pilot [launched at the Palais du peuple with a supplier present, costed at US$4,090,000, about KMF 1,720,000,000, over 2025 to 2028 with World Bank support, targeting 2,000 Comorians trained with 30 per cent women, five mobile science caravans covering about ninety localities a year and 500 small enterprises, with twelve young people trained so far through the supplier partnership, ten of them building projects](2026-01-29-technopole-numerique-phase-pilote-launch-huawei-alwatwan), [previewed the week before](2026-01-24-technopole-numerique-project-preview-2000-youth-worldbank-alwatwan).

No enrolment, completion or spend figure has been published since, and no line of appropriation for it appears anywhere in the 2026 vote. Twelve trained against a target in the low thousands is where the record stands.

summary: Two pupils made a [first Comorian entry to the international artificial-intelligence olympiad in August 2026](2026-08-04-alwatwan-olympiade-internationale-ia-lyceens-comores-kazakhstan).
developments:
2026-08-02 to 08 - [two pupils of a private school, selected from four shortlisted, made the country's first entry to the olympiad, the delegation led by the technology association's secretary-general and funded jointly by the digital agency, its supervising ministry and the association's academy through a programme for emerging nations](2026-08-04-alwatwan-olympiade-internationale-ia-lyceens-comores-kazakhstan). Entry was through a subsidised international programme rather than domestic training capacity, results are not held and the competition ran past the window's close.

The only school-level training on file is a [private foundation's second session at Moroni for about forty secondary pupils, with no third session or programme statement since April 2025](2025-04-15-ai-training-second-session-hazi-haki-foundation-lagazette).

progress: No change, a first mention with no participant count, budget or start date
summary: A [women-entrepreneur training programme is named as a 2025 milestone in a group's own strategy communication](2026-02-02-axian-telecom-next-2030-vision-comoros-techreviewafrica).
developments:
The programme is [named as training of women entrepreneurs across the country, with no participant count, budget or start date](2026-02-02-axian-telecom-next-2030-vision-comoros-techreviewafrica). It is company-reported through a byline-light press wire and the group's own announcement is not held.

Nothing earlier exists to compare it against, so no direction can be stated. The base holds no sex-disaggregated figure for phone ownership, internet use, account holding or training completion for this country, and the one quantified gender target on file is the share of trainees the technology park states it will reach.

summary: [Five mobile science caravans covering about ninety rural localities a year are being launched](2026-01-29-technopole-numerique-phase-pilote-launch-huawei-alwatwan) under the technology park pilot.
developments:
The caravans were [announced on 24 January 2026 as five mobile units covering about ninety rural localities a year](2026-01-24-technopole-numerique-project-preview-2000-youth-worldbank-alwatwan) and [described as being launched at the technology park pilot five days later](2026-01-29-technopole-numerique-phase-pilote-launch-huawei-alwatwan), with no caravan count, route or start date confirmed since.

They are the only named rural digital-divide instrument in the base. No universal service or rural access fund exists for this country, no rural coverage figure is published, and the measurement body that would report one was never created.

summary: A [statistical capacity project funded census-cartography training in April 2026](2026-04-17-inseed-rgph5-gis-cartography-training-statcap-esri-lagazette), against US$1,500,000 over five years.
developments:
The project was described in a note as [US$1,500,000 over five years to close the statistical gap, with no delivery held](2026-04-17-inseed-rgph5-gis-cartography-training-statcap-esri-lagazette).

2026-04-13 to 24 - it [funded a ten-day mapping and field-survey training for the statistics institute with external expertise, ahead of the census in 2027](2026-04-17-inseed-rgph5-gis-cartography-training-statcap-esri-lagazette).

It is the one document in the country-year quoted in dollars and should not be converted into the local-currency series, and no separable domestic statistics appropriation exists - so the country's statistical capability, like its data-protection authority and its interoperability layer, is financed entirely from outside.

summary: The [fifth population census was launched as the first fully digital and geospatial one](2026-08-18-lagazettedescomores-rgph5-digital-census-tools), with enumeration in September 2027.
developments:
2026-08-10 to 17 - a retreat [finalised the methodological and digital instruments, abandoning paper enumeration for tablet-based collection over high-resolution digital cartography and georeferencing, with a pilot phase from September 2026 and general enumeration in September 2027, about 60 per cent of the financing stated as already secured](2026-08-18-lagazettedescomores-rgph5-digital-census-tools). The total census budget is not stated in any held source, so the secured share has no denominator; the census was [officially launched in June 2026](2026-06-09-rgph5-population-census-official-launch-lagazette).

Cartography staff were [trained on desktop and online mapping, field survey and dashboard tools over 13 to 24 April 2026](2026-04-17-inseed-rgph5-gis-cartography-training-statcap-esri-lagazette), with a [separate fifteen-day programme for the territorial development ministry's unit](2026-04-14-comoros-advanced-gis-training-rcmrd-techreviewafrica).

An [annual agricultural survey ran a sensitisation campaign and trained national instructors ahead of rollout](2026-08-07-com-inseed-enquete-agricole-annuelle).

summary: A [European electronic administration project launched on 16 October 2025](2025-10-16-e-administration-project-launch-eu-expertise-france-alwatwan), covering a single online window and interoperability.
developments:
2025-10-16 - the project was [officially launched, its stated scope covering a national portfolio of public services, a single online window, procedures conducted electronically, inter-ministerial interoperability and strengthening of the data-protection legal framework](2025-10-16-e-administration-project-launch-eu-expertise-france-alwatwan).

It is the only European digital-governance instrument the base holds for this country. No financing figure, end date or delivery milestone is stated in any account held, so the launch is all there is - and its interoperability component is the second such layer provided for by a donor project, neither of which operates.
